## OperationUnavailability interface

Why an operation cannot be called.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface OperationUnavailability
```

## Remarks

Each listed position takes a reference to a resource the app has no operation to resolve, so its value type accepts no reference (phases/13 D7, "Resolvable targets"). An optional position like that is left out of the input instead; only a required one makes the operation unavailable.
